emily: Quick blocker on PR #5002 - migrate doc failing linkcheck and missing a compact snippet showing batching + kv_prefetch + quant_profile. Can someone patch with a tiny runnable example?

raj: I9ll do a compact Python + TS recipe. Keep it minimal and add a 1-line back-compat mapping for kv_prefetch.max_tokens -> kv_prefetch.max_prefetch_tokens.

olivia: Also change the broken quant table link to /optimize/quant-profiles#profile-table. Linkcheck shows old internal URL 404.

raj: Python snippet (very small):
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
res = c.generate(
  model="redwood-optimized-7b",
  prompt="Explain kv-prefetch briefly",
  batching={"enabled": True, "max_batch_ms": 15},
  kv_prefetch={"enabled": True, "max_prefetch_tokens": 200},
  quant_profile="latency-tier-1"
)
print(res.text)
```

raj: Rationale: small batch window keeps p50 latency low; prefetch 200 reduces cold-token cost; tier-1 gives mild memory savings. Prefer tier-2/3 when throughput > ~3k rps and small quality loss is acceptable.

olivia: migration checklist to add: run `make docs-linkcheck`, verify /optimize/quant-profiles#profile-table resolves, smoke-run snippet with REDWOOD_KEY and check server log for `kv-prefetch.hit_rate`.
